text:
yara: Huge thanks to @owen and @kelly for tracking down the prototype laptop and sprinting it back to the office — demo saved and the smoothie plans live to fight another day. :muscle:
owen: lol I found it under a stack of conference swag in the cafe. took a heroic jog back. no smoothie was harmed in the rescue. :sweat_smile:
kelly: team effort! left a sticky note on the laptop with a tiny "found" sticker and a granola bar. also high-fived the barista. :clap:
marc: shoutout to @sara too for coordinating with reception and keeping the demo attendees calm. excellent composure under pressure. :trophy:
sara: happy to babysit the attendee check-ins. also I hid emergency backup chargers in the AV bag — lifesaver. :battery:
kudos-bot: Awarded 3 kudos to owen, 2 kudos to kelly, 1 kudos to sara for "Prototype retrieval & calm people wrangling". Logged in weekly recap.
yara: also major props to facilities for fast badge override so we could get the person back in. appreciated.
facilities-bot: Badge override used for visitor retrieval at 13:42. Reminder: please log visitor names in the reception log for security audits.
owen: for the record: granola bars > panic. leaving evidence: <found_laptop_and_granola.jpg> :camera_with_flash:
kelly: mini follow-up: I left a tiny thank-you note and a coupon for the cafe on the laptop case. small kindness goes a long way.
marc: officially adding a kudos entry in the team doc and nominating owen for this week's small-hero highlight.
sara: the attendees loved the calm energy. they even complimented our friendliness. win!
yara: yes! adding to the "small things, big impact" section of the weekly roundup. thanks everyone.
owen: signing off with sticky-glued gratitude. see you at the smoothie fridge. :tropical_drink:
kelly: smoothie fridge tastes better after a rescue. :blush:
kudos-bot: Reminder: Add any extra kudos to the weekly roundup before Friday 5pm.
